newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel's April diamond exports up at $304 mln.
newsitem.headline: Israel's April diamond exports up at $304 mln.

text.p: Israel's exports of polished diamonds in April rose to $304 million from $261 million a year earlier, the Industry and Trade Ministry said on Thursday.
Exports of uncut diamonds jumped to $85 million from $33 million in April 1996.

Exports of polished diamonds for the first four months of the year rose to $1.411 billion from $1.322 billion in the year-earlier period while exports of uncut diamonds amounted to $358 million, up from $237 million.

The ministry said in a statement that while exports of polished diamonds in April rose in dollar terms, the volume declined. The ministry said this reflected Israel's move towards exporting bigger and more expensive stones.
